datasets.name: Financial PhraseBank (AllAgree)
datasets.citation: Malo, P., Sinha, A., Korhonen, P., Wallenius, J., & Takala, P. (2014). Good debt or bad debt: Detecting semantic orientations in economic texts. JASIST.
datasets.domain: Nordic corporate earnings releases, quarterly financial reports, revenue/profit metrics, and dividend declarations.
datasets.upstream_pretraining_relation: CONFIRMED NON-INDEPENDENT: ProsusAI/finbert (Araci, 2019) was fine-tuned on Financial PhraseBank during its initial publication.
datasets.leakage_status: Strictly isolated stratified splits (seed 42). Near-duplicate leakage is < 0.3%.

datasets.name: Twitter Financial News Sentiment (TFNS)
datasets.domain: Financial news headlines, market tweets, equity price actions, and credit rating agency actions.
datasets.regulatory_coverage: Limited: Contains market credit adjustments (e.g. Moody's downgrades), but lacks formal regulatory enforcement and central bank speeches.

datasets.name: Curated Regulatory Risk Benchmark
datasets.license: Internal Project Benchmark (Public Domain Source Documents: US Federal Reserve, SEC, ECB)
datasets.domain: Central bank monetary policy announcements (interest rate hikes/cuts, quantitative tightening), Federal Reserve bank enforcement actions, SEC securities fraud litigation, and ECB executive speeches.
datasets.usage_status: STRICTLY HELD-OUT: Never used for model training, tuning, or weight selection (Safety Rule 9).

regulatory_training_data_assessment.rationale: Transferring a 110M parameter transformer model to legal/regulatory language requires enough support in both positive and negative classes to avoid catastrophic domain forgetting. The 30 benchmark examples must remain strictly held out as an evaluation suite.
